summary: Frontend-only E2E test of STEP 2: HR Kiosk & Attendance (/absen). All 17 scenarios from the review request passed — route loads, 6 nav pills work, live clock ticks, ABSEN MASUK/PULANG disabled gating, staff selection highlight, PIN auto-focus forward, backspace-on-empty moves focus back, clock-in camera modal with GPS '-6.929, 107.774' + MENGUNGGAH → TERVERIFIKASI → toast → kiosk auto-reset, clock-out Rekap Kinerja Shift modal with EXACT stats (Cuci 35kg/9, Kering 45kg/10, Setrika 80kg/28, Packing 77kg/25, Pickup 15kg/5, Delivery 10kg/2) + Jam Masuk 07:14 + Jam Pulang 16:15, WA preview text matches EXACT template with staff name, KIRIM LAPORAN KE WA OWNER opens wa.me/628123456789?text=... with EXACT URL-encoded shift message, LAPORAN TERKIRIM state, both modal close buttons preserve kiosk state, reset-selection-btn works, no regressions on /, /production, /courier, /dashboard, /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: pressing Backspace on an empty PIN box moves focus to previous box but does NOT clear the previous box's digit. Most 4-digit OTP/PIN UIs also clear the previous digit on empty-backspace. Not a functional bug — consider polish if desired.
AttendanceKiosk.jsx is ~740 lines and contains 3 components (kiosk + 2 modals). Splitting ClockInModal and ClockOutModal into separate files would aid maintainability (>700 line guideline).
context_for_next_testing_agent: STEP 2 (Attendance Kiosk at /absen) fully verified in iteration 12. wa.me URL uses OWNER_WA='628123456789' and encodeURIComponent of buildShiftMessage(staffName). window.open was intercepted via init script to capture the URL — the decoded text param exactly matched the required template. Kiosk auto-resets (clears staff + PIN) after successful clock-in/clock-out; modal X buttons intentionally do NOT reset. Minor test quirk: sequence fill('')+click+Backspace on pin-3 can empty pin-2 because native Backspace on the focused (now pin-2) input deletes its char; always re-type full PIN when building subsequent flows.
